[Read more](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/bulletins). **Infrastructure Work in Cavendish area of PEI National Park** From October 14, 2026, to approximately December 2026, road resurfacing work will be undertaken on the Cavendish Campground perimeter road. [Read more](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/bulletins). **Infrastructure Work in Greenwich, PEI National Park** Beginning October 19, 2026, road and parking lot improvement work will take place between the Greenwich Visitor Information Centre and the Greenwich Dunes Trail trailhead and is expected to continue until approximately December 2026. [Read more](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/bulletins). Gentle surf strokes sandy beaches alongside red cliffs and wind-sculpted dunes. Cycle a seashore path, savour a picnic by a lighthouse and spot heron wading in coastal bays. Hike woodlands and overlook ponds watching for red fox, waterfowl and warblers, then head to one of many beaches to build spectacular sandcastles. At sunset, roast marshmallows over a campfire listening to tales and songs - Prince Edward Island National Park is a giant playground for kids of all ages. Features [![Four people strolling on the beach.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/640x360_PE-PEI-2016-06-0129.jpg?modified=20260617171154)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/natation-swim) ### [Ultimate beach experience](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/natation-swim) Ready for a little fun in the sun? PEI National Park is famous around the world for its spectacular beaches, but that’s just the start. [![Cavendish Grove trail](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/Trails-640.jpg?modified=20260623120159)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/sentiers-trails) ### [Trails](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/sentiers-trails) Discover scenic trails located within Prince Edward Island National Park. [![A beige dog on a leash walks along a dirt path surrounded by greenery with its owner on a sunny day. ](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/visit/DogInPark-640.jpg?modified=20260623115748)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/chien-dog) ### [You and your dog](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/chien-dog) Regulations pertaining to domestic animals while in Prince Edward Island National Park ## Most requested - [Subscribe to Parks Canada-PEI Updates](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/tidings) - [Dog walking](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/chien-dog) - [Getting there](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/arrive) ## Visiting Prince Edward Island National Park ### [Plan your visit](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit) Maps and directions, fees, hours of operation, facilities and services. ### [Activities and experiences](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ) Things to do, trails, interpretation programs, beaches and swimming, biking, and more. ### [Hours of operation](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/heures-hours) Find hours of operations for Prince Edward Island National Park. ### [Visitor Guidelines](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/visiteurs-visitors) Learn more about Prince Edward Island National Park guidelines and regulations currently in place. ### [You and your dog](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/chien-dog) There are a number of regulations pertaining to domestic animals while in Prince Edward Island National Park. Learn more. ### [Visitor Safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/securite-safety) Safety information, Prince Edward Island National Park of Canada. ### [Water safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/securite-safety/nautique-water) Whether you’re new to the ocean or a pro, always be aware of the hazards in this quickly changing environment. ### [Fire safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/securite-safety/fire-feu) Learn how to have a safe campfire and which stoves and other heating devices to use during a fire ban at PEI National Park. ## About Prince Edward Island National Park ### [Subscribe to Parks Canada-PEI Updates](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/tidings) Sign up to receive our newsletter "Tidings" for updates at PEI National Park and national historic sites in PEI. ### [Stewardship and management](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/info) Plans and policies, site management. ### [Nature and science](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/nature) Nature and science in PEI National Park. ### [Toquktmekl](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/info/gestion-management-2024) The Mi’kmaq Epekwitnewaq Kapmntemuow and Parks Canada Sign Co-Management Agreement for Parks Canada-administered places on PEI. ### [Important bulletins](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/bulletins) Important bulletins and temporary road closures in PEI National Park. ### [Parks Canada administered land in French River - Park Corner](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/land-terre) A large parcel of land around French River is now administered by Parks Canada. [More information](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/heures-hours) [Subscribe me](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/tidings) to Parks Canada-PEI Updates. ### Social - [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/PEInationalpark) - [Twitter](https://x.com/ParksCanadaPEI) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/pei/pei-dalvay-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126215731)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/dalvay) ### [Dalvay-by-the-Sea National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/dalvay) Surrounded by sand dunes, beaches and a lake, Dalvay-by-the-Sea is a peek into a luxurious Victorian estate. Explore the interior, cycle the shoreline, stroll the grounds or simply relax in an Adirondack chair with a view. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/pei/pei-green-gables-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126215731)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/greengables) ### [Green Gables Heritage Place](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/greengables) Be charmed by an encounter with Canada’s iconic redheaded sweetheart, Anne of Green Gables. Relive the fictional orphan’s youthful adventures at the Island farmstead that inspired author Lucy Maud Montgomery. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/pei/pei-ardgowan-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126215731)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/ardgowan) ### [Ardgowan National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/ardgowan) Stroll the serene and grand grounds surrounding Ardgowan, the former Charlottetown home of William Henry Pope, one of Canada’s Fathers of Confederation who resided and entertained in this cottage-style house during the Charlottetown Conference of 1864. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/pei/pei-province-house-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126215732)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/provincehouse) ### [Province House National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/provincehouse) The birthplace of Confederation and the seat of Prince Edward Island's provincial legislature since 1847, Province House National Historic Site is a Charlottetown highlight. Stroll the grounds to experience the magnificent neo-classical architecture of this majestic building and view interpretive panels. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/pei/pe-skmaqn-lhn-nhs-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126215731)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/skmaqn) ### [Skmaqn–Port-la-Joye–Fort Amherst National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/pe/skmaqn) Established in 1720, Port-la-Joye was the entry point for European settlers coming to Île Saint-Jean to embark on a new life. There are centuries of history to discover in this historic location, declared a national historic site in 1967. Date modified : 2026-10-15

# Accessibility

## Prince Edward Island National Park

Parks Canada is committed to maximizing accessibility so that all visitors have the opportunity to enjoy Canada’s natural and cultural heritage. Prince Edward Island National Park provides public buildings, campgrounds, washrooms, and trails that are open for people with different interests, abilities and accessibility considerations.

## Accessibility

![Une famille se promène sur la promenade menant à la plage.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/Nature/Dunes/babyDunes2-640.jpg)

### Find your favourite beach

There are many beaches to choose from, we are sure you will find a beach that suites you.

- [Supervised beaches](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/natation-swim/plages-beaches)
- Multiple beaches to choose from with different types of access
- [Adaptive equipment](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/accessible#equipment) is available at several beaches
- [Accessible washrooms](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/accessible#wash)
- [Mobility mats](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/accessible#mats)

[Go to beaches](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/natation-swim)

![Sentier de Cavendish Grove](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/Trails-640.jpg)

### Go exploring on the trails

Prince Edward Island National Park offers trails on a variety of terrain, from boardwalk and well-maintained gravel-surfaced paths to single track, natural trail tread.

- Trail difficulty level varies from easy to moderate
- [Accessible washrooms](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/accessible#wash)
- [Trail riders](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/accessible#trail) are available for loan to access features
- Check out the trails webpage before your next visit to get a feel for the trail difficulty and locate facilities

[Go to trails](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/sentiers-trails)

![Bunkies](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/camping/bunkies/NP-bunkies-640.jpg)

### Sleep under the stars

Both Cavendish Campground and Stanhope Campground have accessible facilities, including washrooms and parking. There are selected sites designated for those with limited mobility.

To reserve, call 1-877-737-3783 or visit [reservation.pc.gc.ca](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/reservation.pc.gc.ca).

- Designated sites for those with reduced mobility
- [Accessible washrooms](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/accessible#wash)
- Close to beaches
- Helpful staff
- Multiple camping options which include bunkies, tent and camper sites, and oTENTiks.

[Go to camping](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/activ/camping)

## Landscape and seasonality

Prince Edward Island National Park is very busy during the summer months. During the active beach season, visit [PEI Now](https://www.pc.gc.ca/apps/parksnow?lat=46.336831&lng=-63.143751&z=10&lang=en&siteId=100322) for surf conditions and parking availability. At different times of the year, there may be severe winter weather or high winds; plan accordingly by checking local weather before heading to the park.

It's essential to plan ahead before visiting.

[Plan your visit](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit)

## How to get around here

Stretching approximately 40 kilometres along the north shore of Prince Edward Island between New London and Tracadie bay, and to the tip of the Greenwich peninsula in St. Peters Bay, the park offers many different landscapes that are constantly changing as its shaped by wind and waves.

Travelling from section to section of the park is a considerable distance.  It is recommended that you consult a map before visiting to plan out your route(s) to ensure you see the sights you are most looking forward to.

[Get directions](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/arrive)

## Accessible washrooms

Accessible washrooms can be found at the following locations throughout the park:

- Cavendish Beach
- Cavendish Campground Beach
- Stanhope Beach
- Brackley Beach
- Greenwich Beach
- Cape Turner
- Dalvay Trail House

In addition to these areas, the [Greenwich Interpretation Centre](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/visit/greenwich) also has accessible features to accommodate different interests, abilities and accessibility considerations.

## Adaptive equipment for loan and access features

At Prince Edward Island National Park, the following equipment is available for loan for free from May long weekend to the end of September.

![A woman walks with a two small children on a hard surface mat on the beach facing the water. One child is in a wheel chair. ](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/beaches/mobimat-640.jpg)

### Mobility mats

Mobility mats are special mat surfaces at the base of the beach entrance ramp, which stretch over the soft sand and give access to the hard-packed wet sand along the water’s edge. This creates an easy path of access for wheels of all kinds.

Mobility mats are in place at the following beaches:

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Beach** |  |  |
| Stanhope Beach | Late June | Early September |
| Brackley Beach | Late June | Early September |
| Cavendish Beach | Late June | Early September |

![A family with accessibility needs enjoys a swim in the ocean with a beach wheelchair at Stanhope Beach. Prince Edward Island National Park.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/accessibility-640.png)

### Get safely to the shore in a beach wheelchair

Parks Canada offers two different wheelchairs to suit your desired beach activities. Sand wheelchairs have wider, softer tires, which easily navigate the uneven sand surface. Buoyant wheelchairs have a special design to allow the user to get right in the water.

- Beach wheelchairs are available at Cavendish Beach, Stanhope Beach, and Brackley Beach
- Reserve a beach wheelchair a minimum 2 days in advance by calling 902-566-7050 or emailing [pnipe-peinp@pc.gc.ca](mailto:pnipe-peinp@pc.gc.ca)
- Requires assistance to propel the chair

![A modified wheelchair with one smaller wheel in front that pivots, sits a besides a trail surround by lush green trees and grass on a sunny day.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/activ/trails/trailrider-640.jpg)

### Try out a trail rider

There are three different types of trail-rider wheelchairs to help improve accessibility to the trails in the park. Your experience and feedback on accessibility tools like these trail riders, help to influence accessible options across the country.

- There are three trail riders available to be loaned for free
- Available at Cavendish Campground, Stanhope Campground, and Greenwich
- Trail-riders can be reserved by calling 902-566-7050

## Free entry for support persons

Parks Canada offers free admission and access to programs for support persons travelling with a visitor who has a disability and depends on the support person to travel and experience a Parks Canada destination.

Support people may be family members, friends or aides from an external organization.

Many people with disabilities are independent and may make use of assistance from travelling companions but are not dependent upon it, in which case regular fees are applied.

# Temporary closures at Parks Canada places on PEI

## Prince Edward Island National Park

![Beach closure sign that says: Attention.  Area closed. Endangered species. Active piping plover nesting area.  Minimum fine: $150. ](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/pe/pei-ipe/WET4/securite-safety/PloverSign2a-small.jpg)

\\* When visiting PEI National Park, please respect all signs.

### Beach Closures for Piping Plover

When Piping Plover are present and breeding, signs are posted and the areas are closed to all public use and travel pursuant to section 7(1) of the National Park General Regulations. Anyone found in violation of this prohibition may be prosecuted under Section 7(4)(c) of the General Regulations. The minimum fine for a violation of this prohibition is $150.

## Cavendish - North Rustico

- No closures


## **Brackley - Dalvay**

- No closures


## **Greenwich**

- No closures


#### **Beach Closures for Bank Swallows**

The following areas are nesting habitat for a threatened species, the Bank Swallow (Riparia riparia). When bank swallows are present and breeding, signs are posted and the areas are closed to ALL PUBLIC USE AND TRAVEL by order of the superintendent, Prince Edward Island National Park of Canada pursuant to section 7(1), General Regulations of the _[National Parks Act](https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/N-14.01/)_. The minimum fine for a violation of this prohibition is $150.

**Current closures:** No closures
